Thanks for the options and the materials. I want to be transparent up front: we just had an executive planning sync and the leadership team decided to reallocate our AI engineering cycles toward a mobile rollout and a regulatory readiness effort. That means the LLM inference pilot we discussed is being deprioritized for the near term.

Given that, we won't be able to commit to a live demo next week. I still think Redwood is compelling, and we'd like to keep this conversation open — can we pause scheduling and revisit in Q3? Also please point me to your SOC2 and any enterprise security docs.

Apologies for the back-and-forth — timing shifted on our end.
